hooks.name: Linear Issue Reminder on Commit
hooks.description: Remind agent to include Linear issue reference in commit messages (IDE only, skipped on spot)

action.command: bash -c '[ "$KIRO_SPOT" = "1" ] && exit 0; echo "LINEAR COMMIT CHECK: If this is a git commit command, ensure the commit message or branch name includes a Linear issue reference (CORE-XXX). Check the repo TODO.md or Linear board for relevant issues. If no issue applies, the commit can proceed without a reference."'
